verses.translation: A Song of Degrees. When the Lord turned the captivity of Sion, we became as comforted ones.

translations.ron: Când a întors Domnul robia Sionului ne-am umplut de mângâiere.

verses.translation: Then was our mouth filled with joy, and our tongue with exultation: then would they say among the Gentiles,

translations.ron: Atunci s-a umplut de bucurie gura noastră şi limba noastră de veselie; atunci se zicea între neamuri: "Mari lucruri a făcut Domnul cu ei!"

verses.translation: The Lord has done great things among them. The Lord has done great things for us, we became joyful.

translations.ron: Mari lucruri a făcut Domnul cu noi: ne-a umplut de bucurie.

verses.translation: Turn, O Lord, our captivity, as the streams in the south.

translations.ron: Întoarce, Doamne, robia noastră, cum întorci pâraiele spre miazăzi.

verses.translation: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.

translations.ron: Cei ce seamănă cu lacrimi, cu bucurie vor secera.

verses.translation: They went on and wept as they cast their seeds; but they shall surely come with exultation, bringing their sheaves with them.

translations.ron: Mergând mergeau şi plângeau, aruncând seminţele lor, dar venind vor veni cu bucurie, ridicând snopii lor.
